onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset).

stimulus_description.Description: more specific description of stimulus type

estim_target_region.Description: electrical stimulation target region, if applicable

estim_target_depth.Description: electrical stimulation target depth (cortical layer), if applicable

behavioral_epoch.Description: behavioral epoch when stimulus was delivered

is_running.Description: True if mouse is running during trial, running defined as average speed > 0 cm/s between [-0.5, 0.5] s from stimulus onset

is_valid.Description: True for valid trials, trials are invalid if they have large electrical artifacts or if electrical stimulation was off target

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.trials: The 'trials' table in the NWB file.
Levels.epochs: The 'epochs' table in the NWB file.
